title: Move a job to the next stage

steps.caption: The Pipeline
steps.narration: When a job moves forward, move its card. Here's how, on the Pipeline in the ConstructHUB CRM.

steps.caption: A lead
steps.narration: This flooring job is still a lead. Let's say you've started pricing it.

steps.caption: Choose Estimating
steps.narration: Open the menu at the bottom of the card, and choose Estimating.

steps.caption: Moved to Estimating
steps.narration: The card moves to the Estimating column straight away.

steps.selector: text=drag a card to move it
steps.caption: Or drag the card
steps.narration: You can also drag a card from one column and drop it on another.

steps.caption: The pencil
steps.chapter: Change stage, owner and value together
steps.narration: To change more than the stage, click the pencil on a card.

steps.caption: Stage
steps.narration: Set the stage. This proposal has gone out, so choose Proposal Sent.

steps.caption: Under Proposal Sent
steps.narration: The job is now under Proposal Sent, and the card shows its value.

steps.caption: Approved moves by itself
steps.chapter: The stage that moves by itself
steps.narration: One move happens by itself. When a client approves an estimate, the job moves to Approved.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: You'll find the Pipeline in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to move a job to the next stage | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of moving jobs along the Pipeline in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will move a card with its stage menu, then use the pencil to change a job's stage, owner and contract value together.
